basic_info.description:
Enjoy living in this wonderfully updated single-family, two-story Marina-style home (unfurnished) from the 1920s in the Inner Parkside Neighborhood near Portal Heights. The home has two bedrooms, one full bath and two half bathrooms.

The recently updated interior includes a large kitchen with Caesarstone countertops, stainless steel appliances, a dishwasher, an oven, a vent hood, an electric stovetop, and wood cabinets. The grand living room, with its vaulted ceiling, fireplace, and built-in bookshelves, creates an inviting atmosphere. Two sets of original beveled glass doors accentuate the formal dining room. Both main-level bedrooms boast garden views and open onto a serene, level backyard. A full bath and a half bath round out the main level. The lower level features a spacious bonus room (permitted as storage) and an additional half bath.

People love the beautiful quarter-sawn oak wood flooring covering the entire top floor. The home has an excellent floor plan and a gorgeous painted wood deck in the backyard.
